description: Procedural scattering with Unreal PCG: trees, rocks, fences, lamps along or inside splines, as instanced meshes
name: pcg

tools.description: Scatter copies of builder objects along a spline (both sides of a road, a fence line) or inside a closed spline (a forest, a field) with a real PCG graph (spline sampler, jitter, self pruning), then noise thinning, exclusion zones and ground snapping. Rendered as GPU instances (thousands are cheap). Undoable; same seed = same result.

exclude.description: Keep clear of splines: {spline, clearance cm}

items.description: What to place: {template: node with a builder mesh, weight, scale:[min,max], align (face along the spline), random_yaw, z_offset, collision}

jitter.description: Random position offset (cm, default 35% of spacing)

keep.description: 0-1 share kept, clumped by noise (1 = all)

min_distance.description: Minimum gap between objects (cm, PCG self pruning)

mode.description: along: on/beside the spline; inside: fill a closed spline

offset.description: along: lateral band [min,max] cm from the spline (e.g. [500,1200] keeps trees off a road)

tools.name: pcg.scatter
